title: The Lab
body: The Community Technology Lab supports people of colour to explore, question, and reshape the technologies that impact our lives. Through a 10-week school, six fellows will take part in workshops on digital colonialism, community-centred design, and speculative prototyping, culminating in the creation of either a tool or artwork that responds to needs within our communities. The programme includes dedicated learning time, co-design sessions, guest-led workshops, and a showcase. The Lab aims to expand public participation in technological discourse through hands-on experimentation in order to develop new models for community-led innovation that are inclusive, culturally grounded, and designed with care.
